tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 取而代之；接替上一班的工作；换班

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 洛杉矶之战；美国洛杉矶；洛杉机

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 小睡，打盹儿；细毛；孤注一掷

ex.en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天午饭后，我小睡了一会儿。

ex.en: A brief afternoon nap may improve alertness, but it should not replace adequate sleep at night.
ex.zh: 下午短暂小睡可能提高警觉性，但不应代替充足的夜间睡眠。

col: a power nap｜恢复精力的短睡
tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

ex.en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
ex.zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。

ex.en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。hike通常指较长的户外步行，也可指价格猛涨。

ex.en: One benefit of cycling is arriving home feeling refreshed.
ex.zh: 骑车的一个好处是到家时感觉神清气爽。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.zh: 爱冒险的；大胆的；充满危险的

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1

senses.zh: 可以忍受的；足可支撑的；养得起的；可持续的

ex.en: She chooses sustainable products with little or no plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 她选择塑料包装很少或不用塑料包装的环保产品。

ex.en: Cities should promote sustainable transport by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling infrastructure.
ex.zh: 城市应投资建设可靠的公交服务和安全的骑行设施，推动可持续交通。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。renewable强调可再生；sustainable强调可持续。

ex.en: The heavy base keeps the lamp from falling over.
ex.zh: 沉重的底座让灯不易倒下。

ex.en: Governments should base their environmental policies on reliable scientific evidence rather than short-term political interests.
ex.zh: 政府应以可靠的科学证据而非短期政治利益为依据制定环境政策。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。base A on B表示“以B为依据建立A”。

senses.zh: 排出；耗尽；使精疲力尽；彻底探讨

ex.en: Carrying those heavy boxes upstairs completely exhausted me.
ex.zh: 把那些沉重的箱子搬上楼让我筋疲力尽。

ex.en: Intensive farming can exhaust soil nutrients, reducing agricultural productivity and increasing dependence on artificial fertilisers.
ex.zh: 集约化耕作可能耗尽土壤养分，降低农业生产力，并增加对化肥的依赖。

col: exhaust natural resources｜耗尽自然资源
exhaust all possibilities｜尝试所有可能的办法
tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 1。exhausted 指人累极了；exhausting 指事物令人疲惫。
📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 2

ex.en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
ex.zh: 她把新徽章别在了夹克上。

ex.en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.
ex.zh: 要求访客佩戴醒目的身份徽章，有助于提高学校及其他公共建筑的安全性。

col: a badge of honour｜荣誉的象征
tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 2。通常指佩戴的小徽章；奖牌一般用medal。

senses.zh: 大头针，别针，针；栓；琐碎物

ex.en: She used a pin to hold the fabric together.
ex.zh: 她用一枚大头针把布料固定在一起。

ex.en: Teachers can pin students' artwork to classroom walls to celebrate creativity and encourage participation.
ex.zh: 教师可以把学生的美术作品钉在教室墙上，以肯定创造力并鼓励参与。

col: pin something to｜把某物钉在……上
tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 2。pin作动词时，过去式pinned，进行式pinning。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午探访港口附近的狭窄街巷。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生在选择深造科目前探索不同的职业方向。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。

ex.en: We watched the sun rise over the ocean.
ex.zh: 我们看着太阳从海面上升起。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。
📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

senses.zh: 壁橱；议事室，密室；小房间

ex.en: I hung my winter coat in the hallway closet.
ex.zh: 我把冬季外套挂进了走廊的壁橱里。

ex.en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
ex.zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 3。衣物收纳义多见于美式英语；英式常用wardrobe。

senses.zh: 在旅行中；(剧团等)在巡回演出中
在路上；在旅途中；浪荡世代

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

senses.zh: 转入；接着去做另一件事；进入

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 3

senses.zh: 大量的；实质的；内容充实的

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 4
📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 4

ex.en: We stopped going to that crowded café altogether.
ex.zh: 我们彻底不再去那家拥挤的咖啡馆了。

ex.en: Although online courses improve access, they cannot altogether replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程扩大了学习机会，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 4。altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

senses.zh: 在…过程中；在…期间；在…的过程中

tip: 📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 4
📘 选必1 Listening and Viewing Unit 4

senses.zh: 种子；根据；精液；萌芽；子孙；原由

ex.en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
ex.zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。

ex.en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
ex.zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。

col: plant a seed｜种下一粒种子
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。

senses.zh: （活动或进程中的）稳定阶段，停滞时期

ex.en: We camped on a grassy plateau above the valley.
ex.zh: 我们在山谷上方一片长满青草的高原上露营。

ex.en: Language learners often reach a plateau and may need different study methods to make further progress.
ex.zh: 语言学习者常会进入平台期，可能需要改变学习方法才能继续进步。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。平台期指增长后趋稳，不表示水平开始下降。

senses.zh: 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于

ex.en: I still owe my sister money for the tickets.
ex.zh: 我还欠姐姐买票的钱。

ex.en: Many successful students owe their progress to consistent practice rather than exceptional natural ability.
ex.zh: 许多优秀学生的进步归功于持续练习，而非非凡的天赋。

col: owe an apology｜应向某人道歉
owe a debt of gratitude｜深受恩惠
owe success to｜把成功归功于
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。owe A to B可指欠B东西A，也可指把A归功于B。

senses.zh: （一个地区全部的）生物；生物学

ex.en: We examined onion cells under microscopes in biology today.
ex.zh: 今天的生物课上，我们用显微镜观察了洋葱细胞。

ex.en: A basic understanding of biology helps people evaluate health information and make informed decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 掌握基础生物学知识有助于人们评估健康信息，并对生活方式作出明智决定。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 提高的；高尚的；严肃的；欢欣的
提高；抬起；振奋；提拔（elevate的过去分词）

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西
平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的

ex.en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
ex.zh: 她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。

ex.en: Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
ex.zh: 公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

senses.zh: 位置，方位；职位，工作；姿态；站位

ex.en: Can you move the lamp to a better position?
ex.zh: 你能把灯挪到一个更合适的位置吗？

ex.en: The report explains the government's position on providing affordable housing for young families.
ex.zh: 这份报告阐明了政府在为年轻家庭提供可负担住房方面的立场。

col: apply for a position｜申请职位
take a position on｜对……表明立场
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。

senses.zh: 可获得的；可购得的；可找到的；有空的

ex.en: There are still tickets available for the afternoon show.
ex.zh: 下午那场演出的门票还有余票。

ex.en: Affordable housing should be available to all residents, regardless of their income or employment status.
ex.zh: 所有居民都应能获得负担得起的住房，不论其收入或就业状况如何。

col: available to everyone｜人人都可获得的
make something available｜使某物可供使用
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。available to接使用者；available for接用途。

senses.zh: 矿井；深坑；陷阱；（物体或人体表面上的）凹陷；（英国剧场的）正厅后排；正厅后排的观众
使竞争；窖藏；使凹下；去…之核；使留疤痕

ex.en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
ex.zh: 我们挖了一个浅坑，准备栽这棵新树。

ex.en: Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.
ex.zh: 废弃矿坑可能威胁当地生态系统，除非修复项目能稳固土壤并改善水质。

col: a pit stop｜赛车进站检修
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

ex.en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
ex.zh: 我哥哥对花生和核桃过敏。

ex.en: Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
ex.zh: 学校应制定明确流程，为出现严重食物过敏反应的儿童提供帮助。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

ex.en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
ex.zh: 尽管寒风吹拂，我们还是散步散得很开心。

ex.en: Despite significant investment in public transport, many commuters still prefer driving because services remain unreliable.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通获得了大量投资，许多通勤者仍更愿意开车，因为公交服务依然不可靠。

col: despite the fact that｜尽管事实是
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。后接名词或动名词，不加of；接从句用the fact that。

ex.en: Losing her job caused months of hardship for the family.
ex.zh: 她失业后，一家人经历了数月的困苦生活。

ex.en: Rising housing costs can cause significant financial hardship for families already struggling to afford basic necessities.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能使那些已经难以负担基本生活必需品的家庭陷入严重的经济困境。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。泛指困苦通常不可数；具体磨难可用 hardships。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 献身于…；致力于…（devote的过去分词）

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 不幸的；令人遗憾的；不成功的

ex.en: An unfortunate accident left my bicycle wheel badly bent.
ex.zh: 一次不幸的意外把我的自行车车轮撞得严重变形。

ex.en: It is unfortunate that many rural communities still lack reliable access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 令人遗憾的是，许多农村社区仍无法稳定获得基本医疗服务。

col: an unfortunate choice of words｜不妥的措辞
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。It is unfortunate that…可表示“令人遗憾的是……”。

senses.zh: 事故；意外； 意外事件；机遇

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A。by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 重要情况显露出的小部分，冰山的一角

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 A

senses.zh: 化学家；化学工作者；药剂师；炼金术士

ex.en: The chemist carefully poured the liquid into a glass tube.
ex.zh: 化学研究员小心地把液体倒进玻璃试管。

ex.en: Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 化学家正在研发更安全的材料，以减轻工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。英式中还指药剂师；chemist's常指药店。

senses.zh: 螺旋，螺旋状物； 耳轮

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
ex.zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。

ex.en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

senses.zh: 提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前

ex.en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
ex.zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。

ex.en: Advances in renewable energy technology could reduce dependence on fossil fuels and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 可再生能源技术的进步可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并改善长期能源安全。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: Her passion for baking fills our kitchen with delicious smells.
ex.zh: 她对烘焙的热爱让我们的厨房总是香气四溢。

ex.en: Teachers who share their passion for science can inspire students to pursue careers in research.
ex.zh: 教师分享自己对科学的热爱，能够激励学生投身科研事业。

col: a passion for music｜对音乐的热爱
develop a passion for｜逐渐热爱
pursue your passion｜追求热爱之事
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。表达对某事的热爱，用a passion for。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: Dad shook his head in disapproval at my muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 爸爸看着我沾满泥的鞋子，不满地摇了摇头。

ex.en: Public disapproval of excessive packaging has encouraged some retailers to introduce reusable containers and reduce plastic waste.
ex.zh: 公众对过度包装的不满促使一些零售商采用可重复使用的容器，减少塑料废弃物。

col: disapproval of something｜对某事的不满
a look of disapproval｜不赞同的神情
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。通常不可数；对某事不赞同用disapproval of。

ex.en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
ex.zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。

ex.en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
ex.zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。publish强调向公众发行或公布，不等于仅仅印刷。

senses.zh: 循环；周期；自行车；整套；一段时间

ex.en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
ex.zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。

ex.en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
ex.zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。

col: cycle to work｜骑自行车上班
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

ex.en: The museum displayed an empty bomb casing behind glass.
ex.zh: 博物馆在玻璃后陈列了一个空炸弹壳。

ex.en: Construction projects may be delayed when workers discover an unexploded bomb left over from a past conflict.
ex.zh: 当工人发现过去冲突遗留的未爆炸弹时，建设项目可能会延期。

col: defuse a bomb｜拆除炸弹引信
a bomb disposal team｜拆弹小组
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: After weeks of practice, Hana finally mastered the dance.
ex.zh: 经过数周练习，哈娜终于熟练掌握了这支舞。

ex.en: Students need opportunities to master practical skills rather than simply memorise information for examinations.
ex.zh: 学生需要掌握实用技能的机会，而不只是为考试背诵知识。

col: master a skill｜掌握一项技能
a master of｜某方面的大师
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。动词直接接宾语；硕士学位写作master's degree。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 将财产过户（尤指过户给债权人）

ex.en: The coach assigned each player a partner for practice.
ex.zh: 教练给每位队员安排了一名训练搭档。

ex.en: Teachers should assign tasks that match students' abilities while encouraging them to develop new skills.
ex.zh: 教师应布置符合学生能力的任务，同时鼓励他们培养新技能。

col: assign someone to a team｜将某人分配到团队
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。常用assign sth to sb，也可用assign sb sth。

senses.zh: 被忽视的；不引人注意的；未被注意的

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 女性的；雌性的；柔弱的，柔和的

ex.en: The female lion rested beside her cubs in the shade.
ex.zh: 母狮和幼狮一起在阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Encouraging female students to study engineering can help reduce gender inequality in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 鼓励女生学习工程学有助于减少科技行业中的性别不平等。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

senses.zh: 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。

ex.en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
ex.zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

ex.en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
ex.zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。

ex.en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。

col: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

ex.en: I appreciate the clarity of your instructions for this game.
ex.zh: 你把这个游戏的玩法说明得很清楚，我很喜欢。

ex.en: Greater clarity in public health advice can help people make informed decisions about their daily habits.
ex.zh: 更清晰的公共卫生建议能帮助人们在日常习惯方面作出明智决定。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。不可数名词；clarify是动词，意为澄清。

ex.en: The muddy footprints were evidence that someone had entered.
ex.zh: 泥脚印表明有人进来过。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

ex.en: My watch collects data about how far I walk.
ex.zh: 我的手表会收集有关我步行距离的数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

ex.en: The doctor said a virus was causing my cough.
ex.zh: 医生说我的咳嗽是由病毒引起的。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can limit the spread of a virus by encouraging vaccination and regular handwashing.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传可以通过鼓励接种疫苗和经常洗手来限制病毒传播。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。virus是病毒，bacterium是细菌；两者不能混用。

senses.zh: 信用，信誉； 贷款；学分；信任；声望
相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂

ex.en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
ex.zh: 我们上个月赊购了一台新冰箱。

ex.en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
ex.zh: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。

col: give someone credit｜肯定某人的功劳
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。

senses.zh: 重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的

ex.en: Your spare key was crucial when I locked myself out.
ex.zh: 我把自己锁在门外时，你的备用钥匙派上了关键用场。

ex.en: Access to reliable public transport is crucial for people seeking employment beyond their immediate neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 对于想在居住地附近以外寻找工作的人来说，可靠的公共交通至关重要。

col: crucial to success｜对成功至关重要
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。比important语气强；常用be crucial to。

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I finally made a breakthrough.
ex.zh: 练习了几周后，我终于取得了突破。

ex.en: A breakthrough in battery technology could make renewable energy more reliable and affordable for households.
ex.zh: 电池技术的突破可能使可再生能源对家庭而言更加可靠、更加经济。

col: breakthrough in treatment｜治疗方面的突破
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。名词写成一个词；动词短语break through分开写。

senses.zh: 使…与另一个对等；使…与另一个匹敌

ex.en: I shared my umbrella with a fellow passenger.
ex.zh: 我和一位同行的乘客共撑了一把伞。

ex.en: Students who regularly exchange ideas with fellow learners often develop greater confidence and stronger communication skills.
ex.zh: 经常与同学交流想法的学生往往能增强自信，提高沟通能力。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。

senses.zh: 生（过去式gendered，过去分词gendered，现在分词gendering，第三人称单数genders，形容词genderless）

ex.en: The club welcomes everyone, regardless of age or gender.
ex.zh: 这个俱乐部欢迎所有人加入，不论年龄或性别。

ex.en: Policies promoting gender equality can improve access to education and expand employment opportunities across society.
ex.zh: 促进性别平等的政策可以改善受教育机会，并扩大整个社会的就业机会。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。gender常侧重社会性别；sex常侧重生理性别。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
ex.zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。

ex.en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。

col: unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B。表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。

senses.zh: 正面的；直接的；头朝前的
迎头；头朝前地；正面针对地

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 失去信心；灰心；丧失勇气

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 脱氧核糖核酸（deoxyribonucleic acid）；（美国）国防部核子局 （Defense Nuclear Agency）

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 剑桥大学；英国剑桥大学；康桥大学

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

senses.zh: 威尔金斯；魏尔金；威尔金兹

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 1 B

ex.en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
ex.zh: 在海边散步似乎总能抚慰我的心灵。

ex.en: Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.
ex.zh: 许多文化传统认为，灵魂在肉体死亡后仍然存在。

col: a kind soul｜心地善良的人
not a soul｜一个人也没有
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

ex.en: The holiday looked perfect, but reality was quite different.
ex.zh: 这次假期看起来很完美，但实际情况却大不相同。

ex.en: Although remote work offers flexibility, the reality is that many employees struggle to separate work from personal life.
ex.zh: 虽然远程工作带来了灵活性，但现实是许多员工难以将工作与个人生活分开。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。

senses.en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region
Relating to Australia's Aboriginal peoples, cultures, or languages

ex.en: The exhibition celebrates aboriginal cultures from several different regions.
ex.zh: 这个展览展示并赞颂了几个不同地区的原住民文化。

ex.en: Protecting aboriginal languages requires sustained funding and close cooperation with the communities that speak them.
ex.zh: 保护原住民语言需要持续的资金支持，并与使用这些语言的社区密切合作。

col: Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亚原住民文化
Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亚原住民社区
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

senses.zh: 挤入，压紧；撞击；对…产生影响

ex.en: The new playground had a positive impact on our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 新游乐场给我们社区带来了积极影响。

ex.en: Governments should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before allowing work to begin.
ex.zh: 政府应在批准开工之前评估大型建设项目对环境的影响。

col: have an impact on｜对……有影响
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。名词重音在前；动词通常读/ɪmˈpækt/。

ex.en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.zh: 灿烂的，闪耀的；杰出的；有才气的；精彩的，绝妙的

ex.en: Your brilliant idea saved us hours of work.
ex.zh: 你的绝妙主意为我们省下了好几个小时的工作。

ex.en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
ex.zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

ex.en: This café is full, so let's eat elsewhere.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆坐满了，我们去别处吃吧。

ex.en: When local housing becomes unaffordable, young workers often move elsewhere in search of better living conditions.
ex.zh: 当本地住房变得难以负担时，年轻劳动者往往会迁往别处，寻找更好的生活条件。

col: elsewhere in the world｜在世界其他地方
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A。本身是副词，通常不说in elsewhere或to elsewhere。

senses.zh: (故意回避论点时)以假定为论据的狡辩
回避问题实质；回避问题；转弯抹角回避问题

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 从另一方面来说；在另一方面
一方面…另一方面；但是；表示而另一方面

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 查理曼大帝(742-814, 世称 Charles the Great或Charles I, 768-814为法兰克王, 800-814为西罗马帝国皇帝)

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 A

senses.zh: 最精彩的部分；最重要的事情；加亮区

ex.en: The boat ride was the highlight of our holiday.
ex.zh: 乘船游览是我们假期中最精彩的部分。

ex.en: Recent studies highlight the importance of accessible green spaces for the physical and mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究强调，方便到达的绿地对城市居民的身心健康十分重要。

col: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题
highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性
the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 B。作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。

senses.zh: 地磁的；有磁性的；有吸引力的

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 B

ex.en: That old song has special resonance for my grandparents.
ex.zh: 那首老歌特别能引起我祖父母的共鸣。

ex.en: Stories about migration often have emotional resonance for readers whose families have experienced similar journeys and challenges.
ex.zh: 对于家人经历过类似旅程和挑战的读者，移民故事往往能引发情感共鸣。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 B。情感义常用have resonance for；物理义指共振。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 扫描；浏览；细看；详细调查；标出格律

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 B

senses.zh: 许诺，答应（promise的现在分词形式）

ex.en: Your first attempt looks promising; keep practising every day.
ex.zh: 你的初次尝试看起来很有希望；坚持每天练习吧。

ex.en: Solar energy offers a promising solution for remote communities that lack access to reliable electricity.
ex.zh: 太阳能为缺乏可靠电力供应的偏远社区提供了一种前景可期的解决方案。

col: promising career｜前景光明的职业生涯
promising young artist｜有前途的年轻艺术家
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 2 B。表示有成功的潜力，不等于已经成功。
